lines.text: Many learners say: My grandfather was died last year.
Better: My grandfather died last year.
Died is already the whole verb.
Died! My dog died last week.

data.wrong: My grandfather was died last year.
data.why: Died is already the whole verb.

native.tip: हिंदी में “गुज़र गए थे” जैसा रूप बनता है, इसलिए लोग was जोड़ देते हैं। अंग्रेज़ी में died अपने आप पूरा है।
native.caption: क्या आप भी बोलते हैं: “My grandfather was died last year.” 😅 सही वाक्य है: “My grandfather died last year.” ध्यान रखें: died के साथ was नहीं लगता। Ama की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “died”। याद रखें: died के साथ was नहीं लगता। अब अपना एक वाक्य ज़ोर से बोलिए। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: Many learners add was because of the pattern in their language, but died is already complete.
en.caption: Do you say: “My grandfather was died last year.” 😅 The right sentence is: “My grandfather died last year.” Remember: Died is already complete, so do not add was. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
